gen-vast-shadow-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans reads crisp and modern, with lowercase rising close to the capitals. Vast Shadow brings vintage, eye-catching flair from single-width strokes, and the two feel like different decades sharing one page.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-preahvihear: Ruler-straight and vintage, Vast Shadow keeps a constant width, while Preahvihear opens its letter mouths wide, with a lofty x-height. A constant line against generous openings is the whole appeal.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-roboto: Vast Shadow traces every stroke at the width of one stylus, which gives it a vintage, eye-catching look. Roboto keeps generous mouths on its round letters and little gap between capital height and body height.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Approachable first, thanks to Schibsted Grotesk and its big open e and a. Vast Shadow does vintage showmanship with strokes that never thicken or thin, while the body font keeps its terminals open and its bowls tall.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-sintony: Vintage at heart, Vast Shadow draws every letter without thick and thin parts, while Sintony brings a chunky, tall midzone. Smooth curves and sturdy letters make this pairing hold together.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-sofia-sans: Cut-acrylic crisp, Sofia Sans stands its lowercase tall and rounds its letters with a clearly open side. And Vast Shadow, vintage and eye-catching, cuts every stroke to one width with generous space around each letter.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-sono: Approachable Sono sets tall lowercase with wide default spacing, each a left with its mouth ajar. And with Vast Shadow's constant strokes leading, paragraphs in Sono would drift by without snagging the eye.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-tiktok-sans: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width, no swells. TikTok Sans meets it with an x-height near full cap height and a spacious opening on the c, so the page feels modern.
gen-vast-shadow-source-serif-4: Vast Shadow gives every letter a pipe-cleaner feel and a tall mean line. Source Serif 4 adds dignity, with a hint of wedge-shaped pen pressure in each curve and a gaping c.
gen-zen-dots-fs-hind: Hind reads steadily, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and the ends of its c never turning inward. Zen Dots adds a friendly, techy shout with room around every letter.
